# electric-lead-legato

First real take from the Nothing Phone (4a) (2026-11-13): about 22 s of electric-guitar lead
playing, solo, recorded with the phone's microphone from the amp. Audio only, decoded on the
phone to 22,050 Hz mono and stored here as 16-bit WAV.

Why it's here: new notes often start while the previous note still rings, so each note's energy
rises only 1.2–4× above what came before. The original 4× pluck-attack threshold rejected this
take as "no playing" (fixed in engine 1.0.0+t2). This fixture keeps it detected as playing.
